description: An AI answer engine that searches the web and cites its sources; formerly Perplexica.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-12: a real install of Vane 1.12.2 (formerly Perplexica), upstream's current release proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. Local Store wrote this definition from the project's own deployment instructions.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Written by Local Store from the project's own deployment instructions, not taken from an app store.
Asks on first open for a model provider and its key.
Every question goes to the model provider you choose, and its searches go through the bundled SearXNG, which queries public search engines from this computer.
